args.sql:
WITH chain_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        kod_tsepochki_zapuskov,
        zadanie,
        COUNT(*) AS attempts,
        MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'Успешно' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_success,
        MAX(CASE WHEN nomer_popytki = 1 AND status = 'Успешно' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_ok
    FROM "08_fonovye_zadaniya"
    GROUP BY kod_tsepochki_zapuskov, zadanie
),
chain_flags AS (
    SELECT
        kod_tsepochki_zapuskov,
        zadanie,
        attempts,
        CASE WHEN has_success = 1 AND first_ok = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS retry_success
    FROM chain_metrics
)
SELECT
    zadanie,
    SUM(retry_success) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS share_retry_success,
    AVG(CASE WHEN retry_success = 1 THEN attempts END) AS avg_attempts_retry_success
FROM chain_flags
GROUP BY zadanie
ORDER BY share_retry_success DESC
